format: ONE self-contained HTML file, 1080x1920; deterministic renderAt(t); window.__seek under ?render; edit layer under ?edit=1 (localStorage ws01v2-edits-v1)
continuity_law: The sphere, once born at L6's "direction", never leaves the frame; the map's hero (cat) arrow becomes its embedded arrow; scale, widening, steering and the check all happen to that sphere.

elements.role: The blueprint grid — the drawing-board register of the style experiment; every construction happens on it.
Series furniture: LET'S BUILD IT TOGETHER / THE WORKSHOP — the flagship lane's frame.
The WORD chip: the viewer's naive picture (the machine holds a word), drawn as a labelled tile.
elements.timing: fades and lifts away at the word "numbers" (L1) as the list forms

elements.role: Five number chips (7 / 42 / 0.3 / 19 / …): what a word becomes — a list of numbers.
elements.timing: stagger in at "numbers" (L1); out at L2

elements.role: Caption "A LIST OF NUMBERS" naming the list at the word "list".
The one-number row: a drawn line the five slots sit on — sorting made visible.
CAT 1 / CAR 2 / FISH 3 / BOAT 4 / DOG 5 — each chip lands at its spoken word; the honest one-number attempt.
elements.timing: in per word (L2); out at L4

elements.role: The dashed RELATES? link between neighbours: it draws at "relate" (L3), then its gaps widen — the link cracks — and it fades: the row cannot relate.
The two axes draw themselves in as their poles are named (LAND↔WATER at "land", LIVING↔BUILT at "living", L4) — construction before claim.
The two numbers as words: CAT → ( LAND , LIVING ), then BOAT → ( WATER , BUILT ) — the coordinates spoken in the axes' own terms.
elements.timing: fills at each landing (L5); out at L8

elements.role: The five word chips fly from the row to their coordinates — cat and boat at their spoken words (L5), the rest settling quietly by the line's end.
One arrow per word from the origin: CAT gold (drawn slowly through construction beat 2, in the L5→L6 gap), DOG gold, BOAT cyan, FISH/CAR chalk — a place re-read as a pointing.
elements.timing: draw L6 (CAT in the gap before it); map arrows out at L8; CAT dims as the sphere's arrow takes over

elements.role: The small gold arc + RELATED label: sameness of pointing IS relatedness (L7).
The wide cyan arc: pointing away (L7).

elements.home: born around the hero arrow (centre 296,863, r 292); glides to centre (540,880) at L8
elements.role: THE DIRECTION SPHERE — the WS01 emblem at home: wireframe ball + the embedded gold arrow (the cat arrow, carried over). Born at the word "direction" (L6); never leaves the frame after its birth (the scene's continuity law); glides to centre when the map retires (L8).
elements.timing: wires L6; glide L8; persists to the end

elements.role: The dashed ghost of the previous heading, left behind when the arrow swings (L10) — the direction the context HAD.
elements.timing: in at the swing (L10); out by L11's end

elements.role: Six faint mini-arrows at varied angles: the thousands of numbers are still pointings — many arrows, one sphere.
elements.timing: in at L8's end; out at L12

elements.role: The scale counter racing 2 → 3,072 with its caption NUMBERS FOR ONE WORD: two numbers were the teaching model; thousands are the fact (L8).
elements.timing: counts across L8; out at L10

elements.role: A SENTENCE card + its arrow into the sphere: text at sentence scale points too (L9).
AN INSTRUCTION card + arrow: the viewer's own act enters the geometry (L9); at L10 it glides to the top-centre to perform the re-pointing.
elements.timing: in at "instruction"; glide L10; out at L12

elements.role: THE WHOLE CONTEXT card + arrow: the widening's top rung — the context itself is the arrow now (L9).

elements.home: from the sphere's rim along the new heading
elements.role: The dashed continuation: the model takes the direction and continues it (L11).
The drift ghost: a cyan dashed arrow peeling 20° off the heading at "checked", pulled back onto it at "on the direction" — the check, performed (L11).
The referral: NEXT — CONTEXT POINTS THE WORD / ONE WORD, TWO DIRECTIONS → (dir-01). Silent; bed only.
The narration's words in the picture's empty space, entries on the media clock at spoken words; principals gold.
